# FG-REPO-0005

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 404 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `invisible_private_project_is_not_found` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 指定されたプロジェクトまたはリポジトリが見つかりません。
- en: The project or repository was not found.
- id: Proyek atau repositori tidak ditemukan.

## 原因 (cause)

The resource does not exist, or the caller may not see it. Both cases return the same code so that private resources do not leak their existence (ADR-0010).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `action` and `reason`: `not_visible` (the user is not a member of a private project — check memberships, not the URL), `foreign_token` (another user's token id), or, from the lookup layer, `absent`.

## 対処 (fix)

Check the path; add the user to the project or group if they should see it.
